title: Oral Rehydration Therapy in Children With Mild to Moderate Dehydration
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine parental attitudes towards oral rehydration therapy for children with mild to moderate dehydration.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Parents of dehydrated children aged 0-18

Exclusion Criteria:

* Child with severe dehydration
* Child with chronic disease causing dehydration
study_population: Parents of children suffering dehydration reporting to pediatric emergency room
